Beyond Alliance

Each FSI professional community offers specialized membership with deeper benefits, governance participation, and community-specific credentials. Alliance is the floor every community shares.

Real Estate Professionals

FORCE

$1,495 per year | Certification Required

The destination credential for REO and distressed-property specialists. FORCE Red Book listing, FORCE Connect at events, complimentary Velocity and Five Star Conference registration, and highest FSI Offers allocation.

Visit FORCE →

Financial Services Attorneys

Legal League

$6,500 single-state | $10,000 multi-state

Firm membership for foreclosure, bankruptcy, and mortgage servicing law practices. Practitioner-led Advisory Council, complimentary Five Star Conference and Legal League Servicer Summit registration.

Visit Legal League →

Mortgage Finance

NMSA & MSEA

Invitation-based

NMSA is FSI's C-suite servicer community. MSEA is the senior management pipeline. Members chair the Five Star Executive Council, host Five Star Conference, and meet biannually as standing bodies.

Visit NMSA →  Visit MSEA →

Property Preservation & Services

PPEF

$6,500 per year

FSI's membership organization for the national property preservation companies. PPEF members set operational standards across the preservation industry, with servicers and GSEs participating as institutional partners.

Visit PPEF →
